Fixers: the node makes a fixer's worktree directory, and just's runtime dir is writable (issue 2026-10-29T120308Z-mini-3byv)

Cause: on Linux the sandbox has no patterns, so a fixer could neither
create ../stitch-fix-* (the directory holding the checkout is not
writable) nor write one made later in the turn (Landlock rules are fixed
when the turn's sandbox is built); `just` also failed on its shebang
scripts in $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/just.

Fix: fixer::own_worktree: for a fixer (the issue's named fixer), the
node makes the empty directory <checkout>-fix-<id> beside its checkout
and adds it to the sandbox's writable paths; `git worktree add` fills it.
The goal and the stitch-dev skill now say `just worktree fix-<id>` (no
slug: the node cannot know it). Every sandbox writes
$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/just (made if missing), not the rest of the runtime
directory. `just worktree-rm` tolerates the directory it cannot remove.

Tests: fixer::a_fixer_writes_its_own_worktree,
sandbox::justs_runtime_directory_is_writable; checked by hand under the
real Landlock helper (worktree add into the made dir works, a sibling
elsewhere is refused). docs/self-improve.md §5 and design.md updated.
EOF

check-apple: install rustup targets and toolchain only when missing (issue 2026-10-30T095826Z-tower-eqv6)

`rustup target add` and `rustup toolchain install` write ~/.rustup/tmp even
when all is installed, which a sandboxed shell refuses, so `just check-apple`
(and apps/ios/build-rust.sh) failed on laptop in every agent's shell.

tools/rustup-ensure.sh lists what is installed (only reads) and calls rustup's
installing commands only for what is missing: `targets <t>...` for the active
toolchain, `toolchain <name> <component>...` (profile minimal). The justfile's
check-apple and build-rust.sh use it.

Tested with a rustup shim refusing the writing commands: installed targets,
toolchains and components pass without calling them; a missing target,
toolchain (an exact name, not a prefix) or component calls the install.
EOF

title: Fix harness issue 2026-10-31T110043Z-tower-qrp4 in Stitch, following the stitch-
command:
git add -A && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
Self-improvement: an issue's state is set last, after its note/fix/fixer (issue 2026-10-31T110043Z-tower-qrp4)

Cause: each issue value is a SET record of its own, and the node wrote the
state first (open on a declined landing, fixed on a landing, fixing on
admission, open on a release) and what goes with it (note, fix, fixer)
after. A reader between the two saw the issue [open] without why: land.rs's
a_protected_landing_is_the_users_alone polls until "[open]" and then wants
the decline reason, and failed on tower when it read the issue between the
writes (the "live laptop issue" in the report was its own fixture, filed on
the test node named laptop).

Fix: write the note/fix/fixer first and the state last, everywhere the node
sets them together, and in `stitch issue set` (the fixer check now comes
before anything is written). The existing land.rs test covers it (it waits
for [open] then [fixed] and reads the note and fix with them); it cannot run
inside a fixer's own sandbox (nested Landlock), CI runs it.
EOF
git log --oneline -1
